plan.title: Semantic policy conflicts stay invisible until task check

narratives.Description: Semantic policy conflicts stay invisible until task check. Prefer-A Bound 6050812821.
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#4888 Prefer-A 6050812821)

1. Widen scm three-axis guidance.
2. Extend evaluateSemanticGreen non-cascade validation.
3. Lessons pack entry.
4. Keep #4889 out; no Python SoT.
5. Disclose #633 forge supersession.

conflict_group: mergeable-state-semantic-policy-invisibility

items.title: Widen scm cascade stale-base guidance to three-axis model

narrative.Acceptance: Generalize content/scm/github.md #1369/#2385 cascade stale-base caveat beyond --cascade with three-axis model (textual/behavioral/policy). Operative MUST for conflict-resolve/behind-rebase/pre-push in scm + deft-directive-pre-pr. AGENTS/agents-entry pointer + agents:refresh. Frame #4883 CLEAN as axis-1 necessity.

items.title: Extend evaluateSemanticGreen for non-cascade candidate validation

narrative.Acceptance: Extend evaluateSemanticGreen stale-base limb so non-cascade routes can require candidate validation keyed to (pr_head_sha, target_head_sha). Additive; do not weaken --cascade absolute refusal. Machine-checkable attestation; fail closed names probe. Primary vehicle TypeScript.

items.title: Land lessons pack entry for three-axis semantic policy

narrative.Acceptance: Land lessons entry via lessons pack source with ## Title (YYYY-MM) convention + Canonical-encoding line pointing at probe and scm rule, plus content-contract test.

items.title: Keep #4889 out; withdraw Python SoT shape

narrative.Acceptance: Keep #4889 strictly out. Withdraw #964 optional scripts/check_pr_semantic_drift.py shape; implementers must not satisfy with rejected Python SoT.

items.title: Disclose #633 forge supersession for local probe

narrative.Acceptance: Name #633/#1517 up-to-date-required + Merge gate aggregator as superseding forge-layer control. Scope local probe as interim; state retirement condition. Reject mutating GitHub mergeable_state.
